mode: preregistered independent necessary-condition rejection test; not a positive G1 certificate
question: Do any of the twelve unchanged pilot cells survive an independent test of the necessary scalar operator RMS <= 0.1 condition?
candidate_selection: all original four densities and three epsilons, no selection by observed effect or best pilot cell
geometry: unchanged open Omega4, |t|+r<4, volume=512*pi/3; exact stored binary64 coordinates
cutoff: unchanged chi=h(abs(t))*h(r), h(q)=1 for q<=1, 0 for q>=3, logistic(1/s-1/(1-s)) for s=(q-1)/2 in (0,1)
probes: unchanged first 21 pilot probes: t=-1/2,0,1/2 crossed with spatial origin and six axis points at radius1/2; equal weights1/21
metric: R=sqrt(mean_21(abs(B_C phi-Box phi)^2))/max(sqrt(mean_21(abs(phi)^2)),sqrt(mean_21(abs(Box phi)^2))); target sqrt(E[R^2])<=1/10 for every field
operator: unchanged 4D smoothed BD, a=4*sqrt(epsilon*rho/6), Bphi=a*(-phi+epsilon*sum(w_e(n)*phi)); rho=nu/(512*pi/3), not N/V

statistics.rule: A success requires certified R_lower>1/5. Exact rational binomial tail at p=1/4 <=1/4800 rejects population RMS<=1/10. Report exact-rational lower Clopper-Pearson endpoints and RMS lower=(1/5)*sqrt(p_lower), simultaneously across all120 tests.
statistics.M_rationale: fixed64 gives exact binomial power>0.98 for exceedance probability>=0.6 at the family-adjusted threshold; this is rejection power, not precision of an upper RMS confidence limit
statistics.dependence: independent realizations assumed; fields and epsilon cells may be dependent, Bonferroni does not require their independence
statistics.unavailable: Keep all64 trial slots. Missing/resource/geometry/numerical cases contribute zero certified exceedances, never redraw or drop. The resulting lower bound remains conservative by monotonicity, even with outcome-dependent missingness.
statistics.positive_acceptance: not supported by this lower-bound test; nonrejection is INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS

rng.phase: method_validation, distinct from all development and E4 confirmation streams
rng.sampler: unchanged pilot scalar.points; fresh Poisson(nu), no shell and no redraw
rng.model_limit: independent-stream Monte Carlo assumption; no theorem identifying rounded PRNG coordinates with ideal continuous Poisson geometry

error_budgets.separation: exact dyadic geometry; analytic cutoff field and continuum reference enclosed; exact B error separate from B(input-rounded)-B(exact-input) and float-B minus exact B(input-rounded)
error_budgets.domain: finite-domain and nonlocality errors remain in exact operator error; no reallocation of v0.6 budgets
error_budgets.initial_data_and_solve: not used in local operator stage; a failed necessary operator condition stops before a new propagation ensemble. v0.7 remains separate development evidence, not independent confirmation.

cpu.geometry: v0.7 outward binary64 filters and exact rational fallback; strict null exclusion; all cloud/cloud and cloud/probe relation bitsets, probe interval counts and exact Omega4 membership
cpu.production_coordinates: canonical archived coordinates; regenerated CPU coordinates audit the sampler, not new realizations

stopping.complete_operator_stage: all256 identities and all12 cells, regardless of early failures
stopping.resource_abort: stop on global wall/memory limit, retain every unattempted slot as unavailable; no successful G1 decision
stopping.integrity_abort: source freeze, replay or CPU failure => METHOD_HOLD; no inferential release from a broken implementation
stopping.after_fixed_ensemble: any rejected field rejects its parameter cell; all12 rejected => ALL_TESTED_CELLS_REJECTED; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE_FOR_SURVIVORS; in both cases G1 HOLD pending a complete positive qualification
stopping.no_fermion_run: G2 remains NOT_RUN and Dirac implementation/fit is not started without a separately complete independently passed G1; Flavor and coherence additionally require G2 and G3

required_evidence: direct Q_C psi versus sampled Q psi
Q_C squared versus (B_C tensor I4) on independent test fields
spin/Lorentz transformations on jointly transformed regions and inputs
separate numerical error evidence and source/detector spin structure
